properties.description:
The user tests the implemented graph CRUD workflow against the approved proposal, including reorganizing selected tasks from the earlier-MVP acceptance group, editing dependencies, and the agreed creation/deletion interactions. Check understandable valid/invalid drop feedback, preserved evidence and review history, correct prerequisite enforcement, durable state after reload and refreshed independent views.

Capture feedback and iterate until the user approves. The surrounding graph-editing task is not ready for completion while required review or correction work remains unresolved. This review is followed by the existing updated-MVP-plan review.
properties.title: Review graph editing through the UI
